title: 1917 J. Clark and Son during construction
description: It is announced in the 23rd August 1917 newspaper that J Clark and Son, whose headquarters are at Fredericton, and who have a large farm implement business here under the management of H. N. Dickinson, will soon commence the erection of a large concrete block building on Main Street, directly north of Glass Brothers garage. It is stated that a portion of one of the upper floors may be finished off as a hall for Brighton Lodge, K of P. J Clark and Sons sold mowers, reapers, rakes, binders, International hay loaders, six-row sprayers, Chevrolet cars, Moody thrashers, and Hoover diggers.
